Definition: from G2596 and G4951; to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially:--hale.
BiblicalUsage: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him, lest he hale thee to the judge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe it is better to agree with the adversary on the way than to be dragged before the judge at the end.
